overview.title: Mission brief for the sanctions intelligence dashboard
overview.summary: Use the overview to decide where to focus first. The KPI cards tell you how much data has been ingested, the drift table shows which entities changed role fastest, and the charts show whether growth is coming from more mentions or more relationships.
overview.tour_text: Start with the overview to size the corpus, scan the top drift table, and identify the entities or report years that deserve a deeper review.

entity-resolution.title: How entity resolution works here
entity-resolution.summary: This view groups extracted mentions that may refer to the same actor. Scores are cues for analyst review, not automatic merge decisions. Always read the context and compare the supporting reasons before approving a candidate.
entity-resolution.tour_text: Click a mention, compare the alias candidates, and confirm whether the score is supported by the context and document provenance.

review-queue.title: How to use the review queue
review-queue.summary: The queue highlights unresolved alias suggestions. Approve only when naming, context, and provenance align; reject when the score is driven by superficial string similarity or unrelated contexts.
review-queue.tour_text: Work down the queue, use the reasons and context snippets to make a call, and leave uncertain pairs pending for later corroboration.

provenance.title: Why provenance matters
provenance.summary: Every mention and candidate should trace back to a report, page, and source URL. Provenance is the audit trail that lets another analyst reproduce your judgment.
provenance.tour_text: Use provenance to open the source document, verify the page-level context, and check whether the same actor appears consistently across reports.
